reason: B better targets high-contact-stress service, gives quantitative hardness and wear predictions, and extends prior high-temperature nitriding-plus-texturing work by testing a property-preserving low-temperature oxy-nitrided gradient layer. Its proposal is weakened by the claim that reduced contact area lowers local stress and by lacking oxy-nitrided-only and textured-only controls, but it is still more relevant and testable than A’s moderate-load, potentially damage-promoting porous-layer concept.
